items.cn: 电报与电话作业催生了对头戴器具的需求。

items.en: Headset is used for the single receiver and later for headphones with a microphone.
items.cn: headset 先指单只听筒，后指带话筒的耳机。

items.en: The word extends to computer and virtual reality displays worn over the eyes.
items.cn: 这个词进一步扩展到戴在眼睛上的电脑与虚拟现实显示装置。

note.en: Headset is a transparent compound, so its close relatives are other head and set compounds, while its near meanings are the equipment words around it.
note.cn: headset 是一个意思透明的复合词，因此形近词是其它 head 与 set 复合词，近义词则是周围的设备类词。

entries.definition: the part of a telephone you hold to your ear or mouth
entries.definitionCN: 电话听筒；手机（把 head 换成 hand）

entries.definition: anything worn on the head
entries.definitionCN: 头饰；头部装备

entries.definition: an earphone held over the head
entries.definitionCN: 头戴式耳机（前缀同上，后件不同）

entries.definition: a small device worn in or over one ear
entries.definitionCN: 耳塞；耳机

entries.definition: the part of a phone held to the ear, or a small receiver
entries.definitionCN: 听筒；耳件

entries.definition: a pair of earphones joined by a band
entries.definitionCN: 耳机（成对，无话筒）

normalIntro.en: Headset simply joins head and set, so the picture is a set of small machines put on the head.
normalIntro.cn: headset 就是 head 与 set 的直接组合，画面是一整套小机器搁在头上。

normal.en: Head plus set makes the wearing place and the collection visible.
normal.cn: head 加 set 把「戴在哪里」和「一整套」都写了出来。

normal.en: The plural headsets is regular and very common.
normal.cn: 复数 headsets 规则而常见。

normal.en: The verb take off often pairs with the noun headset.
normal.cn: 动词 take off 常与名词 headset 搭配。

normal.en: Compare handset: swap the first part and you hold it in your hand.
normal.cn: 对比 handset：换掉第一部分，就变成手里拿的听筒。

normal.en: Headphones carry sound only; a headset with a microphone also carries the voice out.
normal.cn: headphones 只收声；带话筒的 headset 还能把声音送出去。

abstract.en: Picture a band snapping over the ears like a pair of goggles.
abstract.cn: 想象一条横梁像护目镜一样扣在双耳上。

abstract.en: Imagine a head with two small loudspeakers and a thin arm reaching the mouth.
abstract.cn: 想象一个头上装着两个小喇叭，还有一根细臂伸到嘴边。

abstract.en: Think of a pilot in a cockpit, sealed off by a headset.
abstract.cn: 想象驾驶舱里的飞行员被耳机封在自己的世界里。

examples.en: The pilot checked his headset before take-off.
examples.cn: 飞行员起飞前检查了他的耳机。

examples.en: Headsets are handed out at the entrance so visitors can hear the guide in three languages.
examples.cn: 入口处发放耳麦，好让观众用三种语言听讲解。

examples.en: Many schools now use a headset to show students ancient sites in virtual reality.
examples.cn: 许多学校如今用头显让学生以虚拟现实参观古迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「黑的塞特」——把黑黑的耳塞子特地去套到头上，就是戴耳机；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 heafod（头）+ set（成套器具，来自古英语 settan「放置」）→ 电话时代的头戴听筒 → 耳机、耳麦 → 头显，核心义「为一颗头配的一整套器具」。

sensesIntro.en: Headset begins with the sound device worn on the head, adds a microphone for speaking, then stretches to any display strapped to the head, and keeps its older sense in telegraph history.
sensesIntro.cn: headset 先指戴在头上收听声音的装置，加上话筒后指通话耳麦，再扩展到任何绑在头上的显示装置，并在电报史中保留了一个较早的义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a band snaps over the head, carrying two speakers and a thin arm towards the mouth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条横梁从上往下扣在头上，带着两个喇叭和一根伸向嘴巴的细臂。

branches.en: The listening sense: sound is delivered to both ears.
branches.cn: 收听线：声音被送到双耳。

branches.en: The talking sense: a microphone turns the set into a two-way kit.
branches.cn: 说话线：加上话筒后，这套器具变成双向设备。

branches.en: The viewing sense: whatever is strapped to the head can be called a headset.
branches.cn: 观看线：凡绑在头上的装置都可称为 headset。

branches.en: The earliest receiver and the modern headphone both put a speaker against the ear.
branches.cn: 最早的听筒与现代耳机都是把发声体贴到耳边。

branches.en: Calls and virtual images both need hands free, which is why the device rides on the head.
branches.cn: 通话与虚拟画面都要求解放双手，这正是设备戴在头上的原因。

intro.en: Headset is a two-part compound whose halves are both ordinary English words, and it spawns a small family of head and hand compounds.
intro.cn: headset 是两部分都由普通英语词构成的双部复合词，并通过 head 与 hand 类复合词扩展出一个词族。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin layer in headset: head and set are Old English words of Germanic origin, so the Latin partners are only the older Germanic roots.
latinIntro.cn: headset 没有拉丁语成分：head 与 set 都是源自日耳曼语的古英语词，拉丁语部分只能追溯到更早的日耳曼语词根。

items.example: Head answers the question where it is worn.
items.exampleCN: head 回答「戴在哪里」。

items.meaning: a collection of things used together
items.example: Set answers the question how many parts.
items.exampleCN: set 回答「由几件东西组成」。

items.example: The suffix forms headsets.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾构成 headsets。

items.example: Headphones is the older sound-only partner.
items.exampleCN: headphones 是更早出现的纯收听同族词。

items.example: The singular names one side of the pair.
items.exampleCN: 单数形式指一对中的一侧。

items.meaning: a telephone part held in the hand
items.example: Handset swaps head for hand.
items.exampleCN: handset 把 head 换成 hand。

items.example: Earpiece names the part that meets the ear.
items.exampleCN: earpiece 指接触耳朵的部件。

items.example: Headgear widens head to all worn items.
items.exampleCN: headgear 把 head 扩展到所有头戴物品。

definition_zh: 医疗保健；医疗卫生；医疗系统；保健服务
definition_en: the services and systems that keep people healthy and treat them when they are ill
core_image: 一只手轻轻托住一颗绿色的心，针管与药盒在一旁待命
scene: 村里老人去医院前总要先算一算，因为账单常常太贵。For many elderly villagers, decent healthcare is still far too expensive.
sceneCN: 这里 healthcare 是「医疗保健」（第 1 个义项：泛指维持健康、治疗疾病的服务）；句意：对许多农村老人来说，获得像样的医疗保健服务仍然太贵。

pos.zh: 医疗保健的；医疗卫生的

derivatives.zh: 由 healthcare 去掉后件 care 得到的核心词，义为「健康」
由 healthcare 拆出的后件，义为「照料；关心」
由 healthcare 加名词构成复合词，义为「医护人员」
由 health 加 -y 构成，义为「健康的」
由 health 加 -ful 构成，义为「有益健康的」

senses.title: The general system of medical services
senses.definition: the whole range of services and institutions that protect health and treat illness
senses.definitionCN: 保护和恢复健康、治疗疾病的整套服务与机构
senses.example: Good healthcare depends on trained staff as much as on money.
senses.exampleCN: 好的医疗保健既需要训练有素的人员，也需要资金。
senses.why: Health names the goal and care names the work, so healthcare is the work of caring for health, taken as a whole.
senses.whyCN: health 指明目标，care 指明工作，因此 healthcare 就是「为健康而做的照料」这一整体事业。

senses.title: Care provided by doctors and hospitals
senses.definition: medical treatment and nursing given by doctors, nurses or hospitals
senses.definitionCN: 由医生、护士或医院提供的医疗与护理
senses.example: The patient needs round-the-clock healthcare after the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 病人术后需要全天候的医疗护理。
senses.why: Narrowed from the whole system to the concrete acts of treating and nursing, the same compound names the service at the bedside.
senses.whyCN: 从整个体系收窄到具体的治疗与护理行为，这个复合词就指病床边的服务。

senses.title: The industry and business of health
senses.titleCN: 医疗产业；卫生健康行业
senses.definition: the sector and business that supplies health services, equipment or insurance
senses.definitionCN: 提供医疗服务、设备或保险的产业部门
senses.example: Healthcare is now one of the largest employers in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 医疗产业如今是该地区最大的雇主之一。
senses.why: Because the service is large and organised, its collective name also names an industry with jobs, firms and markets.
senses.whyCN: 由于这类服务规模庞大且有组织，其集合名称也用来指一个有岗位、有企业、有市场的产业。

senses.title: Government or insurance provision
senses.definition: the public or insured provision of medical services, especially when debated in politics
senses.definitionCN: 由公共财政或保险提供的医疗服务，尤指政治争论中的议题
senses.example: The debate over healthcare divided the two parties.
senses.exampleCN: 关于公共医疗保障的争论使两党分裂。
senses.why: Once the state pays, the word stops meaning care itself and starts meaning a right, a policy and a budget line.
senses.whyCN: 一旦由国家付费，这个词就不再只指照料本身，而开始指一项权利、一项政策和一笔预算。

senses.title: Attributive use before a noun
senses.definition: used in front of a noun to describe something belonging to the provision of health services
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，说明某事物属于医疗卫生服务领域
senses.example: She has worked as a healthcare professional for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 她作为医疗专业人员已经工作了十年。
senses.why: English freely puts the noun before another noun, so the compound doubles as an adjective meaning of health services.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把名词放在另一个名词之前，于是这个复合词也兼作形容词，表示「医疗卫生的」。

intro.en: Healthcare is a modern compound of health and care; the spelling with no space spread in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: healthcare 是现代英语中 health 与 care 的复合词，合写的拼写在二十世纪流行开来。

items.en: Haelth means wholeness or soundness of body.
items.cn: haelth 意为身体的健全与康健。

items.en: Caru means sorrow, anxiety or serious attention.
items.cn: caru 意为忧虑、牵挂或郑重的关注。

items.en: Care shifts from worry to looking after someone.
items.cn: care 由「忧虑」转向「照料某人」。

items.en: Health care appears as a phrase for medical services and later as one word.
items.cn: health care 作为短语出现，指医疗服务，后来合写成一个词。

items.en: Healthcare becomes standard in British and American writing, while health care stays common in the United States.
items.cn: healthcare 在英式与美式写作中都成为标准形式，而分写的形式在美式用法里仍很常见。

note.en: Healthcare is a compound noun that shares its parts with healthcare worker and health insurance, and sits close to medicine, medical care and wellbeing words.
note.cn: healthcare 是复合名词，与医护工作者、医疗保险等说法共享构词成分，意义上靠近医学、医疗照护等「医疗」与「健康」类词。

entries.definition: the condition of being well
entries.definitionCN: 健康（构成本词的前件）

entries.definition: serious attention or protection
entries.definitionCN: 照料；关怀（构成本词的后件）

entries.definition: a person employed to give medical care
entries.definitionCN: 医护工作者

entries.definition: the science of treating disease
entries.definitionCN: 医学；医术

entries.definition: treatment given by medical staff
entries.definitionCN: 医疗照护

entries.definition: help given by the state to those in need
entries.definitionCN: 福利；社会保障

normalIntro.en: Healthcare is two plain words joined: health is the aim and care is the work, so the pair already tells the whole story.
normalIntro.cn: healthcare 由两个朴素的词拼成：health 是目标，care 是行动，这一组合本身就把故事讲完了。

normal.en: Leave out care and you are left with health, the goal of the work.
normal.cn: 去掉 care 只剩 health，那是这项工作的目标。

normal.en: Leave out health and you are left with care, the daily effort.
normal.cn: 去掉 health 只剩 care，那是每天的付出。

normal.en: British writing prefers one word, American writing often keeps two.
normal.cn: 英式写作倾向合写成一个词，美式写作常分成两个词。

normal.en: Before a noun, healthcare works as a plain modifier: healthcare costs, healthcare reform.
normal.cn: 放在名词前时，healthcare 直接作定语，如医疗费用、医疗改革。

normal.en: Etymology runs from Old English haelth and caru, so the worry and the wholeness have always lived in the pair.
normal.cn: 词源可追到古英语 haelth 与 caru，「健全」与「牵挂」一直并存于这一对词中。

abstract.en: Picture a hand cupping a small green heart while an ambulance passes.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手托着一颗小小的绿心，救护车从旁驶过。

abstract.en: Imagine a hospital at night with every window lit and staff moving behind them.
abstract.cn: 想象夜晚的医院，每扇窗都亮着灯，医护人员在窗后走动。

abstract.en: Think of a long chain from a clinic in a village to a ministry in a capital.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长链，从村里的小诊所一直连到首都的部委。

examples.en: The government promised to spend more on healthcare in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府承诺在农村地区增加医疗保健投入。

examples.en: Healthcare costs have risen faster than wages in many countries.
examples.cn: 许多国家的医疗费用上涨得比工资还快。

examples.en: She trained as a nurse and now works in healthcare management.
examples.cn: 她受训成为护士，现在从事医疗管理工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「里头咳儿」——身体里头一直咳，就必需医疗照顾；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 haelth（健全、康健，与 hal「完整」同源）+ 古英语 caru（牵挂、关切，后转为照料）→ 二十世纪复合词 health care → 合写 healthcare，核心义「为了健康而做的照料」。

sensesIntro.en: Healthcare starts as the whole system of medical services, narrows to treatment at the bedside, widens again to an industry, and takes on the political sense of public provision before serving as a modifier.
sensesIntro.cn: healthcare 先指整套医疗服务体系，收窄为病床边的治疗护理，再扩展为产业，又获得「公共医疗保障」的政治含义，最后作名词定语使用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand holds a green heart while a syringe, a pill box and a hospital corridor stand behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手托着一颗绿色的心，身后是针管、药盒与医院走廊。

branches.en: The system sense: the whole range of health services is named at once.
branches.cn: 体系线：一次就指整套医疗卫生服务。

branches.en: The bedside sense: concrete treatment and nursing by staff.
branches.cn: 床边线：医护人员提供的具体治疗与护理。

branches.en: The industry sense: jobs, firms and markets grow out of the services.
branches.cn: 产业线：岗位、企业与市场从服务中生长出来。

branches.en: The political sense: the state or insurers pay, and care becomes a right.
branches.cn: 政治线：国家或保险公司付费，照料变成一项权利。

branches.en: The modifier use borrows the system sense and simply attaches it to a noun.
branches.cn: 定语用法借用体系义，直接贴到名词前面。

intro.en: Healthcare is a modern compound of two Old English words, with care supplying further compounds and suffixes.
intro.cn: healthcare 是两个古英语词构成的现代复合词，care 又派生出一系列复合词与后缀形式。

latinIntro.en: Neither half is Latin: health and care come from Old English and Germanic sources, so there is no Latin entry for this compound.
latinIntro.cn: 两部分都不是拉丁语：health 与 care 都源自日耳曼语的古英语形式，因此这个词没有拉丁语同源条目。

items.example: Health supplies the aim of the compound.
items.exampleCN: health 提供复合词的目标含义。

items.example: Care supplies the activity.
items.exampleCN: care 提供动作含义。

items.example: The spaced form stays common in the United States.
items.exampleCN: 分写形式在美国仍然常见。

items.example: The suffix forms healthy.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾构成 healthy。

items.example: Healthy describes people or habits.
items.exampleCN: healthy 描述人或习惯。

items.example: The suffix forms healthful.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾构成 healthful。

items.example: Careful shows care before a suffix.
items.exampleCN: careful 显示 care 加后缀的造词方式。

items.example: Careless pairs care with the negative suffix.
items.exampleCN: careless 是 care 加否定后缀。

items.example: The compound extends the head word of the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词扩展了整个短语的中心词。

items.example: Health insurance shares the first element.
items.exampleCN: health insurance 与它共享第一部分。
